description.value: Grandt Kitchen is an authentic Filipino restaurant in Surrey, BC, serving traditional dishes like pork sisig, halo-halo, dinuguan, and squid BBQ using time-honored recipes passed down through generations. Located on King George Boulevard, it offers both dine-in and online ordering for pickup or delivery, and has its own mobile app.
